title: All Seven Combinational Families with R/C Filters
description: Final user blueprint normalized to Proteus 74HC266 for XNOR and two-character signal labels. Every logic stage output passes through a current-limiting resistor before becoming the next named node.
expression: N1=A.B; N2=C+D; N3=B xor C; N4=not(N1.N2); N5=not(N2+N3); N6=not(N3); Y=not(N4 xor N6)
hidden_supply_policy: Pin 14 and pin 7 are user-input-only metadata for 74HCxx gates; no explicit IC supply pins are emitted.
terminal_policy: IC signal pins use $TERINPUT/$TEROUTPUT. R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR. Power/ground terminals only appear when passive branches need V0/G0.

normalizations.hidden_supply: Ignore user pin 14/VCC/+5V and pin 7/GND/0V for every 74HCxx package.
normalizations.terminal_policy: IC signal pins use $TERINPUT/$TEROUTPUT. R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR. Power/ground terminals only appear when passive branches need V0/G0.
